name: Glimmerwood
subtitle: Cozy crystal block puzzle
promotional_text: Mine glowing crystals before the roots close in. Sell your haul to Old Puddock, build a cozy camp, and follow the light down. No account. No timers you can pay to skip.
description:
A small mole, a lantern, and a forest that glows at night.

Glimmerwood is a block puzzle you can settle into. Drag crystal pieces onto the board, clear lines, and keep ahead of the Rootline, a vine that slowly closes in around the board. Every line you clear grows it back a little. Then climb out with your haul and sell it to Old Puddock, a toad who has run the market under the stump for longer than anyone remembers.

MINE
• Eleven mines, each with its own crystals and its own trick: embers that shatter their neighbours, frost that freezes the Rootline, geodes worth a fortune, Pilfermoths that nibble at your haul until you clear a line through them.
• Pure veins pay double. Chains stack. One good piece can clear four lines.
• Daily Dig: the same crystals for everyone, once a day. Keep the streak.
• Calm Grove: the same puzzle with no timer at all.

BUILD A CAMP
• Spend your gold on a better lantern, a sharper pickaxe, a root charm, a gem lens.
• Dress Dibble: hats, scarves, lanterns, fur, a cloak or two.
• Your camp grows with you: a tent, a banner, a gem shelf, a hammock, firefly jars, and the little creatures you free from the crystals, who wander about and nap by the fire.

A STORY UNDERGROUND
• 33 Amber Memories, found glowing in the mines, each a piece of what happened the autumn the Glimmeroak fell.
• Granny Burr's chalk marks on the tunnel floors. A toad who won't talk about the stump. Something far below that is still being pulled.

FAIR DEALING
• Crystals are dealt at random. Never by ads, purchases, or how close you are to your best.
• Rewarded ads are optional, and you choose when. Remove the rest with one purchase.
• No account. Your save stays on your phone. Game Center leaderboards if you want them.

Hand-painted in a storybook style, with original music and sounds. In English, Deutsch, Español, Português (Brasil), 日本語, 한국어, 简体中文 and हिन्दी.

Bring a lantern.
whats_new: First release. Eleven mines, a camp to grow, 33 Amber Memories to find, and eight languages.
review_notes:
Glimmerwood is a single-player block puzzle. No account or sign-in is needed; progress is saved on the device.

On first launch the app asks for App Tracking Transparency permission (for AdMob personalised ads). Declining changes nothing about gameplay or the number of ads.

Ads: a banner on the camp and market screens, an occasional interstitial after a finished expedition (never in the first three expeditions, never more often than every second expedition or within 90 seconds), and optional rewarded video ads the player chooses to watch (e.g. 'Puddock's double deal' to double a haul). The piece generator never reacts to ads or purchases.

In-app purchases (via RevenueCat / StoreKit): 'Remove ads' (non-consumable, removes banners and interstitials; rewarded ads stay optional) and four coin packs (consumable). 'Restore purchases' is in Options. Coins never change which pieces are dealt.

To see a full expedition quickly: tap Play, skip the prologue, tap the 'Go mining' signpost at camp, tap Dig. The round ends when the Rootline closes or no piece fits; 'Sell to Old Puddock' returns to camp.

The ring/silent switch mutes the game by design; Options › 'Play sound when the phone is on silent' overrides it.

Game Center: leaderboards only (no multiplayer, no user-generated content).
